reports.title: Customs find 98 kg of marijuana hidden under lettuce
reports.summary: At the South Astara customs post on the Iranian border, officers searching a lorry bound for Russia found 97.685 kg of marijuana in 90 packages under a load of fresh lettuce. The State Customs Committee said the vehicle was carrying the cargo in transit through Azerbaijan and that an investigation had begun.

reports.title: Aceh police find 18 hectares of cannabis and arrest four farmers
reports.summary: A 90-person joint team found about 18 hectares of cannabis in Teupin Reusep, North Aceh, on 27 October 2026 and handed four farmers to police. The plants were one to two metres tall and two to four months old. The site is in the same village where BNN destroyed 69 tonnes in November 2025.

reports.title: Basra court sentences a drug trafficker to death over hashish and meth
reports.summary: The Basra criminal court sentenced a man to death under Article 27(1) of the 2017 drug law after large quantities of methamphetamine and hashish were found in his possession for sale. The Supreme Judicial Council announced the judgment on 27 October 2026. Article 27(1) is one of the law's trafficking provisions and carries death or life imprisonment.

reports.title: The Taliban claim 8,000 anti-drug operations and 10,000 arrests
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry's deputy minister for counter-narcotics said the ministry had carried out more than 8,000 operations against drug suspects in 2026 and arrested more than 10,000 people. He also claimed 4,300 operations to round up addicts and 12,500 operations to destroy poppy fields.

reports.title: Three arrested as dagga lab found in Paarl house
reports.summary: Crime Intelligence and Paarl police raided a house in Lemoenkloof on 27 October, finding a cannabis cultivation lab with plants, products, magic mushrooms and growing equipment. Two men and a woman were arrested for dealing and were due in court on 29 October.
reports.place: De Villiers Street, Lemoenkloof, Paarl, Western Cape

reports.title: 1,200 marijuana plants destroyed in Kibungan in Oplan Grass Cutter
reports.summary: A joint police and PDEA team destroyed 1,200 marijuana plants and 400 seedlings worth P256,000 at Sitio Taba-ao in Kibungan on 26 October 2026. The operation was part of Oplan Grass Cutter.

reports.title: 7.3 kg of kush found in abandoned luggage at Manila airport
reports.summary: Customs found 7,335 grams of kush hidden in food-labelled foil inside three unclaimed bags at NAIA on 26 October, linked to two Bangkok arrivals from September. PDEA, inter-agency police and canine units joined the inspection; no owner has been identified.

reports.title: Army destroys 180 dunums of cannabis near Hermel
reports.summary: The Lebanese Army said it destroyed about 180 dunums of cannabis and seized about 60 tonnes of the crop at Jabab al-Hamr near Hermel on 26 October 2026. A next-day newsletter roundup confirmed the figures and noted a related arrest in Brital.

reports.title: Russia extradites a Turkmen opium suspect charged under the drug-supply article
reports.summary: Russian police in Zabaykalsky Krai arrested a 40-year-old Turkmen citizen who had been wanted since 2025 and extradited him to Turkmenistan in October 2026. Turkmen authorities charged him under article 327(2) with acquiring more than 100 grams of opium for sale as part of a group, an offence carrying up to 20 years.

reports.title: Cordillera police seize P2.7M in drugs, arrest 8 in week of operations
reports.summary: Police ran 12 anti-drug operations across the Cordillera from 19 to 25 October, arresting eight suspects and seizing P2.7 million in drugs. Officers destroyed 1,150 marijuana plants and 1,200 seedlings and seized 20 kilograms of leaves and fruiting tops.

reports.title: Delhi police break courier-based ganja network, arrest three
reports.summary: West Delhi's anti-narcotics squad arrested three men aged 22-25 in Khyala on 25 October, seizing 26.46 kg of Odisha ganja moved by courier in saree, sound-box and RO-purifier cartons. The Bihar-run network used false addresses so couriers would call the boss's own number.

reports.title: Police seize 82 grams of marijuana in Ochamchira
reports.summary: Police in Ochamchira found more than 82 g of marijuana on a local resident in October 2026. They opened a criminal case for illegal purchase, possession and transport of narcotics and placed him under house arrest. At 82 g the amount is above the 50 g especially-large threshold, so the top possession tier of five to seven years applies.

reports.title: Kyrgyz security services seize cannabis and mephedrone worth 15 million som
reports.summary: The State Committee for National Security and the customs service reported on 23 October 2026 that they had detained four Kyrgyz citizens accused of moving and selling drugs from Southeast Asia. Searches recovered mephedrone, hashish and marijuana worth more than 15 million som. The case was opened under the supply article of the Criminal Code and the investigation continued.

reports.title: 146 arrested as online-dealer sweep nets 1.4 tonnes of cannabis
reports.summary: Federal, state and local agencies arrested 146 people across 14 California counties in Operation Central Valley Blues, targeting dealers selling on social media with Meta's help. Officers seized 3,184 lb of cannabis plus meth, fentanyl pills, 43 guns and $338,000.
reports.place: Sacramento County and Central Valley, California

reports.title: 23 kg of hydro weed seized in lamps shipment at Delhi cargo
reports.summary: Delhi Customs found 23.2 kg of hydroponic marijuana vacuum-packed inside a wooden pallet beneath a Bangkok lamps consignment on 21-22 October. One person was arrested; the seizure follows a 148.7 kg bust on 15 October, with 172 kg held across the investigation.

reports.title: Five couriers jailed over 460 kg of cannabis flown to Birmingham
reports.summary: Five members of an eleven-strong smuggling gang were sentenced at Birmingham Crown Court for trying to bring 460 kg of cannabis from Thailand to Birmingham via Paris. The drugs, valued at £13.8 million, were found vacuum-packed in 22 suitcases in August 2024 after Apple AirTags linked the couriers to one account.

reports.title: Ho Chi Minh City arrests 151 in an inter-provincial cannabis ring
reports.summary: Ho Chi Minh City police said on 22 October 2026 that they had dismantled an inter-provincial cannabis ring led by Trần Huy Long, arresting 151 people and seizing 176.2 kg of cannabis and 178 e-cigarettes containing cannabis oil. Eighty-one of those arrested faced criminal proceedings and 70 received administrative penalties.

reports.title: Türkiye destroys 48,579 cannabis plants in Diyarbakır
reports.summary: Jandarma teams raided 35 illegal cannabis plots in Yenişehir, Eğil and Sur with 230 personnel and drones, destroying 48,579 cannabis and skunk plants. The Interior Ministry said the plants could have produced 1.2 tonnes of hashish, and officers seized 36 kg of hashish. The operation was part of the national action plan against illegal cannabis cultivation.

reports.title: Virginia senator indicted for family marijuana enterprise
reports.summary: Federal prosecutors unsealed an eight-count indictment charging 82-year-old state Senator Louise Lucas and six relatives and associates with running a marijuana distribution and money-laundering enterprise from 2019. Lucas faces five counts including racketeering; she surrendered and appeared in Norfolk court the same day.

reports.title: A Raqqa court hands down life for drug trafficking
reports.summary: The criminal court in Raqqa sentenced a man to life imprisonment and a fine of one million new Syrian pounds for possessing narcotics with intent to traffic and use. The court applied Article 40 of the 1993 narcotics law, which carries life imprisonment for trafficking and can reach death with aggravating facts.

reports.title: German arrested in Mallorca over 3.3 tonnes of Canadian cannabis
reports.summary: Spanish police arrested a 44-year-old German resident of Mallorca over a 3,289 kg shipment of Canadian marijuana seized at Valencia port in March, Spain's largest such haul. Charged with trafficking and gang membership, he was freed without bail but barred from leaving the island.

reports.title: Police burn 310,500 cannabis plants on 28 acres in the Upper Berbice River
reports.summary: Police spent over seventeen hours destroying seven cannabis cultivations, camps and drying sheds on savannahs at Wiruni and Sandhills, valued at over GY$165 million. No one was arrested; investigations continue.
reports.place: Wiruni and Sandhills, Upper Berbice River

reports.title: Two arrested with 1,087 bhang rolls in Kiambu and Embu
reports.summary: Police arrested a suspected peddler with 800 rolls of bhang in Juja and a man with 287 rolls in Embu on 21 October, both held for arraignment. The National Police Service says the operations target drug distribution networks.

reports.title: Police arrest ten students over suspected cannabis
reports.summary: Police raided a youth gathering point at Ambatondrazaka and arrested ten students aged 14 to 20, eight girls and two boys, after finding a bag of suspected cannabis.

reports.title: 118 kg of cannabis among RM16.2m haul at Klang temple raids
reports.summary: Selangor narcotics police raided five premises 13-19 October, finding 118 kg of cannabis plus ketamine, ecstasy and 20.6 kg of heroin in an unregistered Klang worship house. Eight suspects aged 19-48, half of them foreigners, were arrested; a part-time temple helper was among them.

reports.title: Immigration police seize five tonnes of cannabis in a Bangkok house
reports.summary: Immigration police raided a rented three-storey house in Bang Khen after neighbours complained about the smell and found more than five tonnes of cannabis flowers. Five foreign nationals sorting the flowers were detained; the licence the operation relied on had been issued for another province.
reports.place: Soi Khu Bon 27, Tha Raeng, Bang Khen, Bangkok

reports.title: Oman's postal parcels keep bringing marijuana
reports.summary: Oman Customs found more than 4 kilograms of marijuana hidden in food bags inside a postal parcel on 19 October 2026. Earlier parcels yielded 2.07 kilograms in September 2024, and 5.4 kilograms from Thailand and 2.56 kilograms from Canada in June 2026. The cases point to small, repeated postal imports rather than one large shipment; no sender or recipient was named.

reports.title: Police seize five tonnes of cannabis in Bangkok
reports.summary: Immigration police raided a rented house in Bang Khen district, Bangkok, on 19 October 2026 and found five tonnes of cannabis buds. They arrested a Vietnamese man and four Myanmar workers who were paid 200–300 baht a day to sort and pack the flower.

reports.title: Woman charged after raid on illegal Ottawa cannabis shop
reports.summary: Ottawa police raided an unlicensed cannabis and nicotine shop on Catherine Street on 19 October, seizing 13 kg of flower, hash, edibles, vapes and more than $10,000. A 32-year-old Ottawa woman was charged with selling and possessing illicit cannabis.

reports.title: Murder-accused man shot dead breaking into cannabis facility
reports.summary: Joel Williams, 23, was found with multiple gunshot wounds at the CANNASVG farm in Georgetown after police answered an intrusion call at around 12:10 am. A second intruder escaped; police say they do not know who shot him and no arrests have been made.

reports.title: NDLEA destroys 7,500 kg of skunk on three-hectare Ondo farm
reports.summary: Acting on intelligence, Ondo NDLEA raided a cannabis farm in the Okemoro Isinbode camp forest on 17 October, destroying 7,500 kg of skunk on three hectares and arresting five named suspects. Officers also kept 1,281 kg of exhibits, including seeds and fresh stems.
reports.place: Okemoro, Isinbode camp forest, Ondo State

reports.title: Georgia's drug crackdown doubles the caseload and fills the prisons
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry registered 5,598 drug crimes in 2024, 10,475 in 2025 and 7,533 in the first half of 2026; more than half were purchase or possession under Article 260. The Prosecutor General's Office opened 119 drug cases against Russian citizens in 2024, 196 in 2025 and 234 in the first nine months of 2026.

reports.title: Police arrest nineteen men consuming cannabis at Namontana
reports.summary: Police arrested 19 men for consuming cannabis at Namontana, Antananarivo, and seized 142 sachets.

reports.title: Twins deny trafficking 26 cannabis cupcakes in Lusaka
reports.summary: University twins Blessings and Gift Kaonga, 20, denied trafficking 26 marijuana-laced cupcakes before a Lusaka magistrate; at trial a DEC officer testified the sisters said they baked to raise school-food money. The 520-gram batch tested at 0.72% THC, over the 0.3% limit.

reports.title: Morocco revokes 1,490 cannabis licences during the 2026 harvest
reports.summary: The cannabis regulator withdrew nearly 1,300 licences from growers and 190 from other operators for breaking licensing rules. The operator licences covered seed imports, processing, marketing, exports and transport. At the same time the agency said 1,100 hectares of the local beldiya variety had been harvested, 60% of the area planted with it, by about 1,800 farmers in 154 cooperatives.

reports.title: Police destroy 30 acres of cannabis in Kandhamal, arrest 9
reports.summary: Kandhamal police used drones to locate and destroy about 30 acres of cannabis in forest land under Luising Gram Panchayat on 14 and 15 October 2026. Nine growers were arrested.

reports.title: Police refuse GH₵50,000 bribe, seize 142 parcels of hemp
reports.summary: The Red Maria team stopped a van on the Bimbilla–Tamale road on 15 October and found 142 parcels of Indian hemp hidden in jute sacks. Four suspects, including the alleged owner, were arrested after officers refused a GH₵50,000 bribe; all were handed to the drug unit.

reports.title: Laos destroys more than three tonnes of dried cannabis
reports.summary: Bolikhamxay authorities destroyed more than 3,000 kg of dried cannabis on 14 October 2026, alongside 6.3 million methamphetamine pills and more than two tonnes of kratom leaves. Vientiane's National Anti-Drug Day burn on 10 October included 8.578 kg of dried cannabis in a 3,894 kg total. The figures are post-conviction destructions, not annual seizures.

reports.title: Six arrested in Taranaki drug raids, cannabis seized
reports.summary: A three-month operation ended with search warrants at two New Plymouth properties, six arrests and the seizure of cash, cannabis, methamphetamine, a rifle and a homemade taser. A 27-year-old woman faces cannabis supply charges and was remanded until 29 October.

reports.title: Army seizes 22 kg of hashish, destroys 14 cannabis tents in Dar al-Wasaa
reports.summary: The Lebanese Army raided wanted men's homes in Dar al-Wasaa, Baalbek, seizing 22 kg of hashish and 22,000 Captagon pills, destroying 14 cannabis-growing tents and arresting two Syrians. The drugs were handed to the authorities and an investigation opened.

reports.title: Man held over cannabis farm and 16 sacks at Volta Lake
reports.summary: Marine police on patrol found a fenced compound and a cannabis plantation behind it at Mangoase on 13 October, arresting 31-year-old Vincent Lotsu and seizing 16 sacks of dried leaves. Police sent the exhibits to the crime lab; Lotsu remains in custody pending arraignment.
reports.place: Mangoase, Central Tongu District, Volta Region

reports.title: 592 acres of cannabis destroyed in Himachal's Parvati Valley
reports.summary: Narcotics, border and state police with forest staff destroyed cannabis across about 592 acres (240 hectares) of high forest in Kullu's Parvati Valley over two months. Plants were cut down on the spot at 2,100 to 3,050 metres, with photos and GPS locations recorded.
reports.place: Parvati Valley, Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh

reports.title: Guatemala reports destroying 34,563 cannabis plants in two areas
reports.summary: Anti-narcotics police destroyed 19,420 cannabis plants near Momostenango, Totonicapán, and 15,143 in Ixmucané, Las Cruces, Petén, the Interior Ministry reported after weekend operations. Prosecutors supported the searches and eradication work. The operations applied the existing cultivation prohibition, which carries five to twenty years in prison plus a fine for unauthorised growing.

reports.title: 3.5 tonnes of hashish seized in farm crates at Tanger Med
reports.summary: Police and customs seized 3,565 kg of cannabis resin hidden in crates of farm produce inside a Moroccan-registered truck at Tanger Med on 11 October. The 35-year-old driver was detained and a judicial investigation opened; no destination was disclosed.

reports.title: Alirajpur police seize 2,079 kg of ganja from two farms, arrest 2
reports.summary: Alirajpur police raided two farms at Chhota Itara on 11 October 2026, seizing 2,079 kg of ganja worth about one crore rupees and arresting two growers. Cases were registered under the NDPS Act.

reports.title: 4.1 tonnes of hashish and smuggling boats seized at Fez farm
reports.summary: Fez judicial police with the DGST raided a rural farm on 10 October, seizing 4.1 tonnes of hashish in a truck plus four inflatable boats and engines. Three suspects were detained, including a woman already wanted nationwide; all are in custody pending a prosecutor-led inquiry.

reports.title: Police find cannabis plants in a car in Töv province
reports.summary: Police in Töv province stopped a group of people aged 20 to 28 with Kibantin tablets and cannabis-type plants in their car. They seized medicines, syringes, a drip set and cash as evidence and said the investigation was continuing. No charge, quantity or court outcome was reported.

reports.title: Tobruk raid finds 400 kg of hashish smuggled from Egypt
reports.summary: Eastern Libyan anti-drug officers found about 400 kg of hashish at a house in an agricultural area southeast of Tobruk. Officials valued it at about 6 million dinars and said it had crossed the Egyptian border for sale in Libya. The detainees were Libyan and Egyptian nationals.

reports.title: Balimo police seize 500 kg of marijuana and arrest five
reports.summary: A police team travelled by dinghy to Gaima village in Balimo, Western Province, and seized 500 kg of marijuana in a dawn raid on 8 October 2026. Five suspects from Nipa-Kutubu in the Southern Highlands and their spouses were arrested; police said locals had harboured them. The suspects and exhibits were being taken to Daru for charges.

reports.title: Hawks arrest two at dagga plantation with firearms
reports.summary: A multidisciplinary Hawks team raided a farm outside Nelspruit on 7 October, finding a dagga plantation, processed extract, two rifles, two handguns and ammunition on expired licences. A 71-year-old man and a 32-year-old woman were arrested and appeared in court the next day.

reports.title: OPP dismantle grow sites in Stone Mills and Madoc
reports.summary: Ontario's cannabis enforcement team searched properties in Stone Mills and Madoc on 7 October, seizing 1,072 plants, processed cannabis and a stolen vehicle worth over $1.8 million. No one was at either site; power was cut over fire and electrical hazards and inquiries continue.
reports.place: Stone Mills Township and Madoc, Ontario

reports.title: Raids in Dortmund and Waltrop uncover grow op and arsenal
reports.summary: Police and prosecutors searched four flats, a company and two snack bars in Dortmund and Waltrop on 6 October, seizing a professional cannabis plantation, firearms and data carriers. A 43-year-old was remanded in custody; three Dortmund men are also under investigation for weapons, cocaine and cannabis trafficking.

reports.title: Algeria seizes 1.66 tonnes of resin on the Moroccan border
reports.summary: Army detachments in Bechar, near the Moroccan border, seized 1,660 kg of cannabis resin in two operations in early October 2026 and killed one trafficker, the defence ministry said. A week later, another 296 kg were seized along the Moroccan border and 51 people were arrested. The operations were part of a weekly series of army drug seizures reported along the frontier.

reports.title: Fifty years for cannabis and heroin taped to a man's legs
reports.summary: The Criminal Court sentenced Abdulla Faseeh to 50 years and a MVR 200,000 fine on 1 October 2026 on two trafficking counts. He had been stopped at Velana airport on 7 October 2024 with 252.17 g of cannabis and 23.60 g of diamorphine taped to his legs before a domestic flight; the court imposed life on each count, calculated at 25 years, and the terms added up to 50 years.

reports.title: 21 arrested as airport baggage-hall drug ring is dismantled
reports.summary: Belgian, French and Dutch police arrested 21 suspects in a Eurojust-coordinated action after an 18-month probe that began with 30 kg of cocaine abandoned at Brussels Airport. Couriers flew in drugs while recruits on cheap tickets collected bags off the belts; cash, cars and guns were seized.

reports.title: Armenia seizes 69 kg of marijuana smuggled from Iran
reports.summary: The National Security Service stopped two Armenian citizens and an Iranian citizen with 69.3 kg of marijuana near Meghri, after they picked up the load from a cache near Nrnadzor. The case was opened under the aggravated sale and smuggling articles, and a court ordered the two Armenians held.

reports.title: Prosecutors seek 20 years for a yakuza who smuggled 646 kg of cannabis
reports.summary: A 53-year-old Japanese-Korean yakuza member went on trial at Suwon for shipping about 636 kg of cannabis from Thailand to Incheon port in March 2026 as part of a 646 kg smuggling operation; prosecutors called it the largest cannabis import for domestic sale and sought 20 years. The case began with intelligence from the National Intelligence Service and was handled by the joint drug headquarters.

reports.title: Two men jailed 30 years and caned for 139 kg of cannabis
reports.summary: S. Mohan, 38, and Ahmad Shamil Abdul Rashid, 28, were sentenced to 30 years in prison and 12 strokes of the cane for trafficking 139 kg of cannabis from a Bangsar car park in 2022. The judge found the case proven beyond reasonable doubt; the prosecution had sought the heavy term over the quantity.

reports.title: West Bank drug arrests reach 2,419 in 2026
reports.summary: Palestinian police in the West Bank said they had handled 2,150 drug cases and arrested 2,419 people, including 50 women, since the start of 2026. More than 100 families had reported relatives to the police in the hope of treatment, the police spokesman said.

reports.title: Mongolia sends more drug cases to court in 2026
reports.summary: By September 2026 prosecutors had charged 398 people under the Criminal Code's drug articles and sent 184 cases involving 270 people to court, 33 per cent more than a year earlier. Just over half of the accused were aged 18 to 30, 44 per cent were 31 to 44, and 15 per cent were women. The figures cover offences under Articles 20.7 and 20.8, not cannabis alone.

reports.title: NCB begins destroying illegal cannabis fields in Kullu
reports.summary: On 25 September 2026 the NCB, ITBP, Himachal Pradesh Police and Forest Department began a month-long drive to destroy illegal cannabis cultivation in remote parts of Kullu. The teams geo-tag and film the plots and the Forest Department issues destruction certificates; the NCB said legal action would follow against those responsible.

reports.title: 391 kg of cannabis found in glove boxes at Pasir Panjang port
reports.summary: ICA image analysts flagged anomalies in a container's scan on 24 September and found 1,290 cannabis blocks hidden in boxes of gloves. The agencies say the 391 kg load was transiting through Singapore; no origin or destination was disclosed and investigations continue.

reports.title: Police seize 270 kg of cannabis in a week-long trans-Tasman operation
reports.summary: A week-long Australia–New Zealand operation in September 2026 carried out 85 search warrants in New Zealand and arrested 34 people. Police seized 270 kg of loose cannabis and 6,183 plants, along with methamphetamine, opium, MDMA, cash and firearms. The cannabis came from grow houses in Auckland linked to Vietnamese organised crime.

reports.title: Singapore intercepts 391 kg of cannabis in a transit container
reports.summary: Border officers and narcotics investigators found 1,290 cannabis blocks weighing about 391 kg in boxes containing gloves at Pasir Panjang. Their 2 October release said preliminary investigations indicated the container was transiting Singapore for another country and that investigations continued.

reports.title: French Polynesia jails Huahine cannabis producers
reports.summary: The Papeete court sentenced Huahine producers to three years, two suspended, and a 2.5 million CFP fine; distributors received two years suspended and a 500,000 CFP fine. Police had seized 2 kg of cannabis, 177 sticks and 4.5 million CFP in cash. The case followed the August seizure of 513 kg of plants and cuttings on the island.

reports.title: Northern Cyprus reports 218 participants in supervised drug programmes
reports.summary: An official account of an addiction symposium reported 218 participants in supervised-release programmes. The figure covered drug cases generally and described the work of the Prime Ministry’s drug commission.

reports.title: Hong Kong seizes a record 535 kg of cannabis at sea
reports.summary: Customs seized about 535 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, worth about HK$125 million, from a container that arrived from Thailand declared as carrying insulated boxes. Officers found the drug in 364 of 1,342 boxes and arrested three men after a controlled delivery; one was charged with attempting to traffic.

reports.title: Nine arrested as police raid cannabis grow houses across Canberra
reports.summary: Police searched 15 properties across the Australian Capital Territory and seized 1,586 cannabis plants, about 70 kg of dried cannabis, cash and six vehicles. Nine people were charged with criminal-group and drug offences in what police called their largest ever operation against grow houses.

reports.title: Cannabis charges fall slightly but imprisonments hold steady
reports.summary: The Ministry of Justice's cannabis offences tables for the year to 30 June 2026 show 5,690 finalised charges, down from 5,854 a year earlier, and 3,543 people charged, down from 3,606. Convictions were stable: 2,551 people were convicted, against 2,600 in 2024/25, and 558 received imprisonment as their most serious sentence, about 22%.

reports.title: Two Malaysians arrested with 10 kg of cannabis at Tuas
reports.summary: ICA officers stopped a Malaysia-registered motorcycle at Tuas Checkpoint on 15 September 2026 and found about 10,164 g of cannabis in bundles under the seat and in a haversack on the handlebar.[@1] A 36-year-old Malaysian man and a 35-year-old Malaysian woman were arrested.[@1] The drugs were worth more than S$203,000 and could feed about 1,450 abusers for a week, and the amount was twenty…

reports.title: Azerbaijan seizes 5.9 tonnes of marijuana in eight months
reports.summary: In January–August 2026 the authorities recorded 5,561 drug crimes and seized 6,994.958 kg of narcotics and psychotropic substances, valued at 208.47 million manat, the State Commission for Combating Drug Addiction reported. Marijuana accounted for 5,928.805 kg and hashish for 247.630 kg, and officers also took 17,372 cannabis plants out of circulation.

reports.title: Cambodia charges five Britons over 97 kg of cannabis and heroin at its new airport
reports.summary: Kandal Provincial Court charged five British men with possession, trafficking and transport under Article 40 after two stops at Techo International Airport. On 6 September officers seized about 18 kg of cannabis and heroin from two of them; on 9 September they found 73.017 kg of dried cannabis and 6.219 kg of white powder suspected to be heroin in the luggage of the other three.

reports.title: Drukair employee arrested with 22 kg of cannabis
reports.summary: Police arrested a Drukair employee in his forties on 14 September 2026 over an attempt to smuggle 22.34 kg of cannabis. The case was reported in October and was one of several large airport and parcel seizures that year. It was an enforcement case, not a change in the law.

reports.title: DRI seizes 740 kg of cannabis and charas in a fortnight of raids
reports.summary: Between late August and 9 September 2026 the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence seized about 740 kg of cannabis and charas in eight operations and arrested 13 people. The largest haul was 375.95 kg of ganja from two trucks near Raipur; officers also found 140.5 kg near Patna, 69 kg near Ludhiana and 5 kg of charas smuggled from Nepal.

reports.title: Vietnam reports 407 kg of cannabis seized in the first nine months of 2026
reports.summary: At a 7 September 2026 inter-agency conference, the drug police reported 17,600 cases and nearly 35,400 suspects since the start of the year. Seizures included 407 kg of cannabis, 99.8 kg of heroin, 953 kg and nearly 900,000 pills of synthetic drugs, and 1.16 tonnes of ketamine. The case and suspect figures cover all drugs; the cannabis figure is a seizure total.

reports.title: Qatar customs find hashish hidden in candy wrappers
reports.summary: A passenger arriving at Hamad International Airport was stopped with 1.5 kilograms of hashish and 370 grams of methamphetamine concealed in candy wrappers and sweets. The General Authority of Customs said officers found the contraband during a luggage inspection and referred it to the authorities. The seizure was announced on 3 September 2026.

reports.title: Algeria plans a drug enforcement agency and a desert prison
reports.summary: The High Security Council, chaired by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, decided on 2 September 2026 to create a specialised drug enforcement body modelled on the US Drug Enforcement Administration and to turn an army barracks at Tanezrouft in the Sahara into a high-security prison for drug traffickers. The presidency announced no legal text or start date.

reports.title: Cannabis grower jailed for life for shooting burglar dead
reports.summary: Adrian Frost, 61, was jailed for life with a 27-year minimum for murdering Connor Batty, who broke into his Hemsworth home with two others to steal his cannabis crop. Frost lay in wait with a sawn-off shotgun after first calling 999; the accomplices received up to four and a half years for the attempted burglary.

reports.title: Nueva Alianza 57: 222 hectares destroyed in Paraguay's forest reserves
reports.summary: In twelve days, Paraguay's anti-drug agency and Brazil's Federal Police destroyed 222 hectares of cannabis and 44 growers' camps, much of it inside nature reserves such as Mbaracayú and Morombí.

reports.title: French Polynesia seizes half a tonne of cannabis in Huahine
reports.summary: Customs seized 794 cannabis plants and 208 cuttings, about 513 kg, in Huahine and destroyed them on site. The raid was one of the largest cannabis seizures reported in the territory.

reports.title: Police shut a cannabis grow-house syndicate and seize five tonnes
reports.summary: Police announced on 25 August 2026 that a 10-month investigation had shut down a Vietnamese-organised cannabis grow-house syndicate in Auckland. Twelve people were arrested in 19 raids; police seized about NZ$1.25 million of cultivation equipment, 35 kg of cannabis and NZ$80,000 in cash.

reports.title: Oman police seize 185 kg of drugs and arrest seven in Al Barka
reports.summary: Police in South Al Batinah arrested seven Asian nationals in Al Barka after finding more than 185 kilograms of narcotics, including crystal meth, hashish, marijuana and morphine, and more than 120,000 psychotropic tablets. The Royal Oman Police said the group intended to traffic the drugs. The statement did not give a separate cannabis weight or say where the shipment entered Oman.

reports.title: Mauritanian police seize hundreds of kilos of resin in a summer crackdown
reports.summary: Police and gendarmerie units announced a run of raids in July and August 2026, breaking up at least ten networks and arresting dozens of people. The largest seizures were 202 kg of cannabis resin hidden in food shipments, 230 kg in a truck trailer at Bassiknou and 210 kg at Nouadhibou, alongside smaller amounts and thousands of psychotropic tablets.

reports.title: Northern Cyprus police seize suspected cannabis in Famagusta
reports.summary: Police reported finding 1.2 kg of suspected cannabis and a precision scale in an operation in Famagusta. Two men were arrested and the investigation continued; the announcement did not report a conviction.

reports.title: Sukhumi airport customs find 4.8 grams of cannabis on a passenger
reports.summary: On 19 August 2026 customs officers at Sukhumi airport found 4.8 g of cannabis in the luggage of a 38-year-old Russian citizen during a pre-flight check. He was detained and handed to the interior ministry. The amount was just above the 4 g large-amount threshold, so the case could be prosecuted in the aggravated possession tier rather than as simple possession.

reports.title: NDLEA destroys two cannabis farms in Edo and makes eleven arrests
reports.summary: Nigeria's drug agency destroyed 1.85 hectares of cannabis in the Igbanke forest and arrested eleven people, nine of them young men at one spot in Benin City. An opposition politician called the burning of farms a waste: "You cannot burn your way out of poverty."

reports.title: Bangladesh files its first case under the new digital drugs offence
reports.summary: The Department of Narcotics Control filed a case against Daraz's managing director, a supplier and two or three unidentified people over THC-infused CBD oil it said had been sold on the e-commerce platform. The case was filed on 16 August 2026, after a raid in Badda arrested the supplier and recovered oil, materials and equipment.

reports.title: Djibouti gendarmes seize 12 kg of cannabis in Balbala
reports.summary: The Einguella gendarmerie brigade broke up what it called a cannabis distribution network in the Balbala district of Djibouti City, finding 88 packages weighing 12 kg at a storage site, with an estimated street value of 1.76 million Djiboutian francs. Several people were arrested, held in police custody before presentation to the justice authorities.

reports.title: Police seize 144 kg and arrest 1,875 people in seven months
reports.summary: Police said 1,141 drug operations between 1 January and 31 July 2026 seized more than 144 kg of drugs and 1,856 bottles of alcohol, and led to 1,875 arrests. They searched 23,249 people and more than 7,300 places, opened 1,533 cases and sent 634 to the Prosecutor General; 116 foreign nationals were handed to Immigration for deportation. The figures covered all drugs and did not separate cannabis.

reports.title: Odisha police destroyed cannabis on 36,500 acres in one season
reports.summary: In the 2025–26 growing season, police in six districts of Odisha destroyed cannabis on 36,508 acres (about 14,775 hectares) in 1,631 mapped plots. The state now tells revenue officials to watch the same land as the next season starts.
reports.place: Malkangiri, Koraput, Rayagada, Kandhamal, Gajapati and one other district, Odisha

reports.title: Nepal's drug arrests rise again
reports.summary: Narcotics Control Bureau data for the 2025/26 fiscal year showed 1,768 people arrested in anti-trafficking operations and 993 cases registered, with 1,325 charged and 1,113 remanded in custody. Police seized 1,603 kg of cannabis, 204 kg of Thai cannabis, 41.5 kg of hashish and 13.347 kg of cocaine, with a total market value of Rs 857.75 million.

reports.title: South Korea's coast guard arrests 249 poppy and cannabis growers
reports.summary: A four-month sweep from April to July 2026 caught 236 poppy growers and 13 cannabis growers, seizing 29,438 poppy plants, 37 cannabis plants and 5.5 kg of cannabis. The coast guard said cultivation was concentrated in rural and island areas and promised tighter sea-border checks.

reports.title: Cousins grew cannabis in rented Yongin villas and sold it online
reports.summary: Two cousins grew cannabis under LEDs and climate gear in two rented Yongin homes from last October to July, selling marijuana, jelly and liquid online for up to 1 million won a time. Police acting on a resident's tip arrested them on 6 August, seizing 35 plants, 2.3 kg and cryptocurrency.

reports.title: Police seize 245 kg of hashish in Panjshir
reports.summary: Anti-narcotics police stopped a shipment of 245 kilograms of hashish in the Kotol Anjuman area of Paryan district, Panjshir province, and arrested four people. The suspects were referred to judicial authorities after initial questioning. The ministry did not say where the shipment was going.

reports.title: 48,000 cannabis plants burned in a Kalinga communal forest
reports.summary: Drug agents and police spent two days uprooting and burning 48,000 cannabis plants on 6,000 square metres of a communal forest in Tinglayan, in the mountains of northern Luzon. No one was arrested.

reports.title: Cambodia reports 16,498 drug suspects in seven months
reports.summary: An Anti-Drug Department report counted 16,498 drug suspects in January–July 2026, 10% more than the 14,977 a year earlier; 889 were foreigners. Authorities seized 2.51 tonnes of illicit drugs and 105 kg of dried cannabis, against 1.91 tonnes in the same period of 2025. The figures cover all drugs.

reports.title: Tetere police uproot 300 cannabis plants as the grower escapes
reports.summary: On 2 August 2026 officers at Tetere station uprooted more than 300 marijuana plants at the riverside near Ngalimera community in North Guadalcanal. The suspected grower ran off before police arrived and no arrest was made. Police repeated that cultivation is a serious offence under the Dangerous Drugs Act.

reports.title: South Korea's cannabis arrests fall by a quarter as smuggling hits a record
reports.summary: The 2025 drug crime white paper recorded 2,459 cannabis offenders, down 25.9% from 3,317 in 2024 and 4,085 in 2023; use fell to 1,016 while smuggling rose to 335. Overall drug offenders rose 1.7% to 23,403, and smuggling offenders hit a record 1,772. Seizures included 128.6 kg of herbal cannabis and 5.6 kg of resin.

reports.title: Yemen's government reports about 1.3 tonnes of drugs seized in first half of 2026
reports.summary: The interior ministry's drug-control administration reported about 1.3 tonnes of drugs seized in government-controlled areas in the first half of 2026: 613.7 kg of hashish, 617.6 kg of methamphetamine, 100 kg of heroin, 4 kg of opium, more than a million Captagon pills and 41,768 other pills.

reports.title: Police seize 3.3 tonnes of cannabis in Saptari
reports.summary: On the night of 23 July 2026 police in Saptari stopped three vehicles at Tilathi Koiladi-5 and found 3,332 kg of cannabis packed in 100 sacks. The drivers fled and no arrests were reported. It was one of the largest single cannabis seizures in Nepal, in a period when police reported a record 51,439 kg seized in the previous fiscal year.

reports.title: South Korea blocks 22 imported 'hemp' foods after finding drugs
reports.summary: The food and drug ministry tested 32 overseas-purchase products marketed with cannabis, hemp or kanna and found controlled substances in 22 of them, including cannabis compounds and the temporary narcotic mesembrine. It asked customs to hold the products and platforms to block their sale, and warned that importing or eating them is punishable.

reports.title: South Korea indicts 12 people for growing cannabis at home
reports.summary: The joint drug headquarters indicted 12 people, six of them detained, after a four-month sweep of home and factory grows; those charged included a hip-hop group member, an English teacher and a composer. Investigators seized about 3 kg of cannabis, 39 plants and cannabis jelly, and said ordinary residents were treating home growing as an entry drug.

reports.title: Kyrgyzstan reports three arrests over cannabis teas and oils
reports.summary: Police reported detaining three suspects after investigating cannabis products prepared for a festival in Tuura-Suu and searching homes and a shop.[@1] The Interior Ministry said laboratory tests found marijuana in two sample packages; searches also recovered cannabis oil, marijuana, seeds and products marketed as teas and other goods.[@1] A supply investigation was continuing when the arrests…

reports.title: Syria seizes half a tonne of hashish in Sweida
reports.summary: The Drug Enforcement Administration said it foiled an international smuggling attempt in the southeastern countryside of Sweida and seized nearly half a tonne of hashish. It said the drugs belonged to outlaw groups operating in the province and that the operation was run with the Internal Security Command in the Badia. The announcement gave no arrest figure.

reports.title: Bangladesh counts 105 border points used by traffickers
reports.summary: A report in July 2026 counted at least 105 border points in 18 districts used to bring in narcotics of all kinds. Authorities seized 96,358 kg of cannabis in 2025, down from 114,345 kg in 2024.

reports.title: Bangladesh arrests 20,439 on drug charges in a 72-day sweep
reports.summary: Police headquarters said 20,439 people were arrested on narcotics charges during a nationwide operation from 1 May to 12 July 2026, part of nearly 117,000 arrests for all offences. Officers filed 14,157 drug cases and seized 5,336 packets of cannabis along with yaba, heroin, phensedyl and liquor. The operation ended the day before parliament passed the 2026 narcotics amendment.

reports.title: Kazakhstan's 2026 cannabis campaign finds 40 plantations in ten days
reports.summary: In the first ten days of the 2026 Karasora operation, police recorded 187 drug offences, including 46 sales, 40 cases of cultivating drug plants and four of smuggling. They seized 760 kg of drugs, among them more than 121 kg of synthetic drugs, and 266 kg of precursors. A separate case in Astana involved 245 g of alpha-PVP packed in 227 sachets.

reports.title: Palestinian police seize 23 kg of hashish in Jericho
reports.summary: The PA anti-narcotics police seized 230 slabs of hashish weighing 23 kg in Jericho and the Jordan Valley, worth more than 500,000 shekels. Police said the haul was meant for distribution in several governorates and some for smuggling across the border; no arrests were announced in the first statement.

reports.title: California seizes 63,000 pounds of unlicensed cannabis in three months
reports.summary: Between April and June 2026, California's cannabis task force destroyed or seized 63,204 pounds of cannabis and 89,257 plants in ten counties, and arrested 24 people.
reports.place: Kern, Alameda, Butte, Los Angeles and six other counties

reports.title: Thai police warn couriers after 4.5 tonnes seized abroad
reports.summary: Thai police warned travellers after 4.5 tonnes of cannabis said to have come from Thailand were seized in Hong Kong, Indonesia and Poland: 23 kg in Hong Kong, 3.37 tonnes in Indonesia and 1.2 tonnes hidden in construction bricks in Poland. The force said couriers could face life imprisonment or the death penalty abroad, although Thailand itself has no death penalty for cannabis.

reports.title: Indonesia seizes 3.37 tonnes of Thai cannabis buds in East Java
reports.summary: A joint BNN, customs and East Java police operation from 29 June to 1 July 2026 found 3.37 tonnes of cannabis buds from Thailand in 500 suitcases and 80 cartons at a warehouse in Gresik. Twelve people were arrested, including a Chinese national; BNN said the buds were intended to be turned into THC vape liquid.

reports.title: Uzbek security services find 714 cannabis plants in a Shahrisabz greenhouse
reports.summary: The State Security Service said a man in Shahrisabz had built a greenhouse on a 5.3-hectare plot at his home and was growing 714 cannabis plants for sale; the dried material weighed 201 kg. In a separate case in Tashkent, a previously convicted man was stopped with 1.994 kg of hashish said to have been smuggled from a neighbouring country. Criminal cases were opened in both.

reports.title: Ten years on, drug-war killings continue under Marcos
reports.summary: Human Rights Watch marked ten years since Duterte launched the drug war with a report that Marcos had never repudiated it or rescinded its orders. The Dahas Project counted 1,273 killings in the anti-drug campaign since Marcos took office in June 2022, including 330 in 2023–2025, while police reported about 6,200 deaths under Duterte and rights groups estimated up to 30,000.

reports.title: Moldovan border officers seize suspected cannabis seeds from a passenger
reports.summary: Border and customs officers at Costești found 50 suspected cannabis seeds in a passenger’s baggage on a coach arriving from Belgium. The seeds were sent for expert examination and the investigation continued.

reports.title: Togo reports over 50 tonnes of drugs seized, mainly cannabis
reports.summary: Togo reported that security forces had seized more than 50 tonnes of drugs in 2025, mainly cannabis, alongside 52 kg of cocaine and psychotropic drugs. Security minister Calixte Madjoulba pointed to the seizures as evidence of anti-trafficking work.

reports.title: Brunei drops a capital cannabis charge and jails the man for nearly six years
reports.summary: A man arrested in January 2016 with 756.33 g of cannabis had faced a trafficking charge that carried the death penalty. In June 2026 prosecutors replaced it with two charges of possession for trafficking, covering 200 g of cannabis and 84.17 g of cannabis mixture, and he pleaded guilty.

reports.title: Myanmar burns more than 50 tonnes of seized drugs
reports.summary: On the UN International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking, the regime burned more than 50 tonnes of heroin, opium, ketamine, methamphetamine, marijuana and crystal meth, valued at about US$600 million, in Yangon, Mandalay and Taunggyi. The total was more than double the 2025 figure. No marijuana weight was given.

reports.title: Syria launches 'Syria Without Drugs' with a tally of the crackdown
reports.summary: The interior and health ministries launched a national anti-drug campaign at a ceremony in Damascus attended by President al-Sharaa.

reports.title: A Bali court gives a Dutch cannabis grower three years, not death
reports.summary: Police arrested a 31-year-old Dutchman and his Russian wife on 1 October 2025 after finding a hydroponic cannabis farm in their rented Denpasar house. Prosecutors sought nine years, but the Denpasar court convicted him under the plant-cultivation article and sentenced him to three years and a Rp510 million fine on 23 June 2026.

reports.title: Belarus reports more drug sentences served under restriction of liberty
reports.summary: The Prosecutor General’s Office reported that restriction of liberty made up 48% of drug sentences in the previous year, with personal-use offences its most frequent application. Short custodial sentences rose from 0.14% to 3.4% of sentences. The figures covered drug offences generally and followed the 2025 expansion of sentencing options.

reports.title: Misrata customs seize more than five tonnes of cannabis resin
reports.summary: Customs officers at Misrata Free Zone port found 4,752 blocks of hashish, each about 1.15 kg, hidden among other goods in two containers. The haul totalled more than five tonnes and one Libyan man was arrested. Prosecutors in East Misrata supervised the case.

reports.title: Iran says drug arrests passed 500,000 in 1404
reports.summary: Iran's Drug Control Headquarters said more than 500,000 retailers, distributors and people connected to drug offences were arrested in the Iranian year 1404, which ended in March 2026. It said seizures rose about 3% from 1403 but gave no cannabis breakdown.

reports.title: Ten arrested as parcel-post cannabis ring supplying France is dismantled
reports.summary: French and Spanish police arrested 10 suspects and searched 24 premises in a Eurojust-coordinated action week, breaking a ring that moved about 1.4 tonnes of cannabis from Barcelona to Rennes by post since 2024. Cash, drugs, guns and cars were seized; the network's assets are put at €4 million.

reports.title: Kosovo police seize about 60 kg of suspected marijuana
reports.summary: Police searched locations in Pristina and Babush near Ferizaj after several months of investigation, seizing about 60 kg of suspected marijuana, two cars and a truck. Four suspects were arrested and the prosecutor ordered 48 hours of detention while proceedings continued.

reports.title: China's cannabis user numbers fall again in 2025
reports.summary: The 2025 drug situation report recorded 27,000 drug crime cases, 41,000 suspects and 33.5 tonnes of drugs seized, with 134,000 users handled. It counted 15,000 existing cannabis users at the end of 2025, down 4.7%, and 3,000 cannabis users punished during the year, down 30.2%. Of 20.5 tonnes seized from foreign sources, the report named methamphetamine, heroin and cannabis as the main types.

reports.title: UAE police seize marijuana and hash oil in a 23-person raid
reports.summary: The National Anti-Narcotics Authority and Ras Al Khaimah police arrested 23 people and seized marijuana, hash oil and synthetic cannabinoid materials in a nationwide operation. Two were arrested while transporting drugs, 11 more were linked to a ringleader based abroad, and 10 were held in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ajman.

reports.title: India's narcotics bureau reports 634 tonnes of cannabis seized
reports.summary: The Narcotics Control Bureau's annual report for 2025 counted 633.59 tonnes of cannabis seized, about half of all drugs by weight, up from 540.8 tonnes in 2024 but below the 816.9 tonnes of 2021.

reports.title: Vietnam sentences two cannabis traffickers to death over 401 kg
reports.summary: On 12 June 2026, the Quảng Ninh provincial people's court sentenced 18 defendants in a cannabis ring that had used Telegram to take orders and arrange payment. The court found more than 401 kg of cannabis had been traded between 2023 and June 2024. Nguyễn Phi Cơ and Nguyễn Duy Mạnh received death sentences; Nguyễn Tuấn Anh received life.

reports.title: Moldovan police uncover a cannabis-growing site at Vadul lui Vodă
reports.summary: Police reported approximately 2.5 kg of cannabis and a growing site in an investigation involving two men suspected of cultivation and supply. One suspect was detained for 72 hours while the other was investigated at liberty; both retained the presumption of innocence.

reports.title: Macau breaks its cannabis record with a 35 kg airport haul
reports.summary: A 25-year-old Hong Kong man was arrested at Macau International Airport with about 35 kg of cannabis flower in two suitcases, packed in 60 packets, after arriving from Southeast Asia. Police valued the haul at about MOP35 million and called it the largest cannabis case in Macau's history, eight months after the previous record.

reports.title: Jordan sentences a man to death for killing three anti-narcotics officers
reports.summary: The State Security Court sentenced a man to death on 7 June 2026 for the killing of three anti-narcotics officers. The court convicted him on five felony counts, including three counts of assaulting officers enforcing the narcotics law that resulted in death, and ordered the confiscation of all seized items.

reports.title: Taiwan seizes 766 kg of cannabis in its largest bust in a decade
reports.summary: Coast guard and police officers stopped a truck in New Taipei's Rueifang district early on 3 June 2026 and found 1,309 packages holding 766.09 kg of dried cannabis flower, along with amphetamine and mixed drugs. The coast guard valued the haul at about NT$1.62 billion and said it was its largest cannabis seizure in ten years; seven people were arrested and prosecutors indicted them on 24 August.

reports.title: Lesotho court dismisses the Srugo cannabis case
reports.summary: The criminal case against Tom Srugo under section 9(1)(a)–(b) read with section 6 was dismissed for lack of prosecution, and a court order directed the return of 337 plants and 4 kg seized from his Thetsane residence in 2024. Police had still not returned the plants by October 2026, and the Ministry of Health was withholding a licence renewal.

reports.title: A 13 kg heroin load crosses Turkmenistan undetected and is caught in Uzbekistan
reports.summary: Uzbek customs found 13 kg of heroin in a truck carrying dried apricots from Afghanistan to Russia at the Olot border post on 30 May 2026. The truck had crossed Turkmenistan, and Turkmen customs had not found the drugs on either entry or exit. The case was reported by Hronika on 4 June and highlighted the gap in Turkmen border checks.

reports.title: Court closes a 'drug cafe' on Fuvahmulah for 85 days
reports.summary: The Fuvahmulah City Magistrate Court ordered a drug café at Gulisthanuge closed for 85 days, the first such closure outside Malé. Police said anyone entering the property during the order would commit an offence and promised the strictest action for trespass or damage. The Criminal Court had closed drug cafés in the capital before; this order came from a magistrate court on Fuvahmulah.

reports.title: South African pilots intercepted with 500 kg of cannabis
reports.summary: A Federal Airlines aircraft landed unlawfully at Moshoeshoe I airport with 500 kg of cannabis from Thailand, allegedly destined for South Africa. The pilots were fined M200,000 for unlawful landing and sent back; police denied that it was a cannabis seizure. The cannabis and destination claims were allegations, not court findings.

reports.title: Samoa charges 55 people after twenty drug raids
reports.summary: The acting police commissioner said 20 raids between January and May 2026 led to 55 charges, including 12 women aged 18–47 and 43 men aged 16–53. Seizures included just over 100 g of methamphetamine, marijuana plants and joints, and firearms. The figures cover all drugs.

reports.title: 2.7 tonnes of hashish seized at Sète in Morocco–France inquiry
reports.summary: Gendarmes stopped a vehicle coming off the ferry at Sète on 24 May and found 2,692 kg of cannabis resin, then arrested the network's suspected logistics chief near Paris. The Lille-led inquiry, run with Moroccan intelligence, says part of the load was bound for Lille.

reports.title: Gabon prosecutors burn seized cannabis and other drugs in Libreville
reports.summary: Libreville prosecutors destroyed three truckloads of seized drugs, including cannabis, in the presence of Justice Minister Augustin Emane. The ministry valued the combined haul at nearly five billion CFA francs and said the operation aimed to prevent seized drugs from returning to sale.

reports.title: Family ties and absent defendants stall Timor-Leste's cannabis case
reports.summary: The first trial hearing in the 13-defendant case was adjourned without a new date because three defendants did not appear and some judges were related to defendants. The defence asked the Superior Council of the Judiciary to decide whether the judge should stay on the panel. The case had already been in court for nearly four years.

reports.title: Police find 70 seedlings in an indoor cannabis farm
reports.summary: Drug-control officers dismantled an indoor marijuana farm and arrested four Kuwaitis, seizing 70 seedlings, a kilogram of prepared cannabis, a firearm and ammunition. The Interior Ministry said cultivation for trafficking can bring death or life under the 2025 law. The raid showed that small indoor grows, not only imports, supply some users.

reports.title: Sana'a court jails 12 in hashish trafficking and use case
reports.summary: The Specialized Criminal Court in Sana'a sentenced four men to 25 years for possessing and distributing hashish with intent to traffic and for preparing a place for its use. Three others got five years for possessing hashish for use, five got one year for preparing drug-use premises, and one was acquitted.

reports.title: Abkhazia convicted 29 cannabis growers in two years
reports.summary: In April 2026 the prosecutor general's office reported that courts had handled 33 drug-plant cultivation cases in 2024–2025 and convicted 29 people. Twelve received real prison terms, nine suspended sentences and four were sent for compulsory treatment; fines came to 2.45 million roubles. Police seized 598 cannabis roots, mostly South Krasnodar, and 547 opium poppy roots.

reports.title: Kuwait's appeal court confirms death for 120 kg of hashish
reports.summary: The Court of Appeal upheld death sentences for three Iranians caught by the coast guard near Kobar Island with more than 120 kilograms of hashish and 10,000 psychotropic pills. They confessed and said each would be paid KD10,000 for delivering the shipment. The case confirmed that cannabis resin trafficking can still end in a death sentence.

reports.title: The US Coast Guard hands Haiti a boat carrying 1.5 tonnes of marijuana
reports.summary: The United States Coast Guard stopped a vessel about eight nautical miles off Môle- Saint-Nicolas carrying about 3,200 pounds of marijuana, valued at 3.8 million dollars, and detained one person. The cargo and the suspect were handed to the Haitian authorities for prosecution.

reports.title: Jordan's drug crimes fall by 12.8 per cent in 2025
reports.summary: Jordan's Public Security Directorate recorded 22,031 drug crimes in 2025, down 12.8 per cent from 25,260 in 2024. Possession and use fell 10 per cent to 15,720 and trafficking 19 per cent to 6,311. A separate human-rights report had compared 2025 crimes with 2024 arrests, producing a misleading 34 per cent drop.

reports.title: Guangdong police seize 735 kg of cannabis at sea
reports.summary: On 26 April 2026 a joint police and coast guard operation intercepted a freighter in the South China Sea and seized 735 kg of cannabis, arresting five people. Police described the route as running from Southeast Asia through Chinese waters to overseas buyers. The case was one of five major drug operations published by Guangdong's public security department on 22 June 2026.

reports.title: Sri Lanka seizes 110 kg of kush at Colombo airport
reports.summary: On 26 April 2026 police arrested 22 Sri Lankan monks returning from Thailand at Bandaranaike International Airport with 110 kg of kush hidden in their luggage, valued at about US$3.5 million. It was reported as the country's largest single cannabis seizure. The case was an enforcement event, not a change in the law.

reports.title: Investigation counts 1.2 million drug cases and a revolving door
reports.summary: Netra News reported that law enforcement agencies filed about 1.2 million narcotics cases between 2009 and July 2025, naming more than 1.5 million accused. Cannabis accounted for more than 99 per cent of seizures by weight, while heroin and cocaine together were under 1 per cent.

reports.title: Police charge a Zimbabwean man over a 500 kg cannabis farm
reports.summary: Clifford Nkomo, 51, was arrested at a farm in Gantsi and charged with unlawful possession and unlawful cultivation after police reported about 500 kg of cannabis worth P250,000, plus about 1 kg in sachets. He was remanded to 27 April 2026.

reports.title: Singapore hangs a courier for one kilogram of cannabis
reports.summary: Omar bin Yacob Bamadhaj, 46, was executed for importing 1,009 grams of cannabis. The court found he had only carried the drugs, but Singapore's law left the judge no sentence other than death.

reports.title: Nepal Police shoot more drug suspects as trafficking rises
reports.summary: A Kathmandu Post investigation counted 17 police shootings in drug operations in three years: six in 2023/24, two in 2024/25 and seven in 2025/26 by April. Two men were shot in Kathmandu and Rupandehi on 7 April 2026, and 11 of those shot or arrested in the cases were Indian nationals.

reports.title: Singapore seizes 36 kg of cannabis at Changi Airport
reports.summary: A 25-year-old Portuguese man who arrived at Changi Airport Terminal 2 on 14 April 2026 was stopped for checks, and 68 packets holding about 36.3 kg of cannabis were found in his luggage.[@1] He had been due to leave Singapore the next day.[@1] The amount was more than 70 times the 500 g threshold for the death penalty; the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority said investigations continued, and…

reports.title: Army and police seize 155,000 cannabis plants in Udawalawe reserve
reports.summary: Acting on army intelligence, Hambegamuwa police and soldiers raided a three-acre cannabis field inside the Udawalawe reserve on 11 April and seized about 155,000 plants worth Rs 4.5 million. The reports name no arrests.

reports.title: Bahrain seizes more than 100 kg of cannabis from Iran
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry said on 11 April 2026 that anti-narcotics officers had seized more than 100 kg of marijuana and hashish worth about BHD1.5 million and arrested three men. The drugs came from Iran through dead drops and were moved in two boats; cash, smuggling equipment and the boats were seized, and the case went to the Public Prosecution.

reports.title: Mongolia's anti-drug police report 143 crimes in early 2026
reports.summary: In the first quarter of 2026 the police anti-drug department recorded 143 drug crimes involving 210 suspects, and 45 more crimes involving 54 suspects in joint operations with intelligence and customs. It said it had stopped an amount equal to 27,671 single doses, without giving a weight or a cannabis breakdown. The figures cover all controlled drugs.

reports.title: Police seize 300 kg of hashish in Helmand
reports.summary: Counter-narcotics police seized 300 kilograms of hashish in Helmand province and arrested four people, the Interior Ministry said. In the same round of operations police recovered 2,800 intoxicating tablets in Jalalabad and 1,000 tablet K pills in Herat. The ministry said the suspects would face legal action.

reports.title: Japan records its highest number of cannabis investigations
reports.summary: Police investigated a record 6,832 people for cannabis offences in 2025, 754 more than the year before, the National Police Agency said on 2 April 2026.[@1] About 700 were pursued under the new offence of use, and 1,373 were under 20, the highest since 1990.[@1] More than 40% of those under 30 said they had bought cannabis through apps such as X and Telegram, and police seized 315 kg of…

reports.title: A man is jailed for taking 25 kg of cannabis on a domestic flight
reports.summary: A 56-year-old South Australian man was sentenced to three years in prison on 25 March 2026 for trying to take 25 kg of cannabis on a domestic flight from Adelaide to New South Wales. Airport staff became suspicious of his suitcase in August 2024, and he pleaded guilty to a Commonwealth trafficking charge in August 2025. The District Court set a non-parole period of one year.

reports.title: Morocco seizes nearly 12 tonnes of cannabis near Essaouira
reports.summary: Police stopped three commercial vehicles with forged plates in the countryside outside Essaouira and found 11,755 kilograms of cannabis. The drivers ran off, leaving the drugs and ten false plates; a parallel search at Sidi Kaouki turned up another vehicle. The operation was run by the DGSN with the DGST, local authorities and the royal gendarmerie.

reports.title: New Zealand's cannabis possession charges reach an eight-year high
reports.summary: Ministry of Justice figures reported in March 2026 showed 3,438 people charged with possessing cannabis in 2025, up from 2,881 in 2024 and 2,287 in 2023, the highest number since a 2019 law change told police to consider a health-based response first.

reports.title: Cannabis reports rise even as Hong Kong's overall drug abuse falls
reports.summary: Hong Kong recorded 5,077 reported drug abusers in 2025, down 2 per cent from 2024, but the number who reported cannabis rose from 678 to 705. Cannabis was the second most common drug among people under 21 after etomidate, with 263 young users. Police arrested 4,108 people for drug offences, up 27 per cent, and cannabis was one of the three main drugs involved; the conviction rate was 86 per cent.

reports.title: Bayda court gives life terms to cannabis growers
reports.summary: The Bayda Criminal Court convicted five men of cultivating cannabis for trafficking on a farm in Wadi al-Akki. Three received life imprisonment and a 50,000-dinar fine each; two received ten years and a 3,000-dinar fine each. All five lost their civil rights, and the ruling was reported on 15 March.

reports.title: North Macedonia withdraws six more cannabis cultivation licences
reports.summary: The government announced a further six cultivation-licence withdrawals following the Health Ministry commission’s inspections. Its spokesperson attributed the decisions to failures to meet legal conditions. These were individual licensing decisions within the medical cultivation system.

reports.title: Police data show no cannabis fines since 2022
reports.summary: A Freedom of Information request found that Israel Police issued no administrative fines for personal cannabis possession or use between 2022 and 2025, after thousands in 2020–21. Police said the enforcement framework for the 2022 regulations was still being designed, leaving the fine scheme on the books but unused.

reports.title: Tunisia counted 14,300 drug-trafficking cases in 2025
reports.summary: The interior ministry reported on 7 March 2026 that 2025 brought 181,998 judicial cases in total, 14,300 of them drug-trafficking cases, and 69,164 arrests, 20,289 for drug trafficking. It also reported seizures of cannabis, 479,830 tablets, 146.77 kg of cocaine and 751.25 g of heroin. The figures cover police and national guard, not customs.

reports.title: Police seize 35 kg and arrest thirteen at Ambohimanarina
reports.summary: A raid on a house used as a depot and consumption lounge at Ambohimanarina, Antananarivo, found 35.054 kg of cannabis and led to 13 arrests: four wholesalers and nine dealers or buyers. All were jailed at Antanimora.

reports.title: A lawyer gets life for hashish flown from London
reports.summary: The Criminal Court sentenced a well-known lawyer and a Kuwaiti fugitive in London to life for trafficking hashish and psychotropic substances sent by air cargo. A young woman and another Kuwaiti received seven years each. The case showed that air cargo from Europe, not only Gulf sea routes, supplies the market.

reports.title: Montenegro police file complaints against two more Trnovo suspects
reports.summary: Police filed supplementary criminal complaints against two men from Zeta, aged 42 and 49, on suspicion of drug production and supply linked to the Trnovo cannabis plantation.[@1] Investigators cited forensic examinations, analysis of traces and other collected evidence; three earlier suspects had already been processed.[@1] The case began with the discovery of about 13,100 plants near Bar in…

reports.title: Moldova reports cannabis trading alongside a growing synthetic-drug market
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry told parliament that marijuana and hashish remained present in seizures while synthetic drugs were growing. It reported 737 people sent to trial for drug offences in 2025; this figure covers all drugs.

reports.title: Vlasenica police issue a public marijuana-use ticket
reports.summary: Republika Srpska police reported seeing a person consume marijuana in a public place in Vlasenica and issuing a misdemeanour notice under Article 17 of the public-order law. The bulletin records one enforcement action, not a national arrest total or a criminal conviction.

reports.title: Bhutan seizes 28.5 kg of cannabis in postal parcels
reports.summary: Police arrested three people after finding 28.51 kg of cannabis in two parcels: 12.91 kg in bean cans at Bhutan Post and 15.6 kg in an air compressor. Further Bangkok consignments brought the total to more than 33 kg by early March, with four Bhutanese and two Indian nationals arrested. The case was an enforcement event, not a change in the law.

reports.title: Fiji destroys 18.2 tonnes of marijuana in Operation Sasamaki
reports.summary: Police reported that nine phases of Operation Sasamaki, launched on 1 March 2025, destroyed 18.2 tonnes of marijuana with an estimated street value of FJ$241 million and arrested 1,239 people, mostly for possession and cultivation. The same operation seized 11.1 kg of methamphetamine and cocaine worth nearly FJ$7 million.

reports.title: Cambodia jails two Britons for a 19.9 kg cannabis export attempt
reports.summary: The Phnom Penh municipal court sentenced two British nationals to 14 and 10 years and a total 24 million riel fine for using, possessing, trafficking and transporting cannabis. They had been arrested at Phnom Penh airport on 17 June 2025 with 19.9 kg of dried cannabis before a UK flight. The 14-year term exceeds the 5–10 year band for 8–20 kg, suggesting aggravation or a charging issue.

reports.title: North Macedonia withdraws six medical cannabis cultivation approvals
reports.summary: The government withdrew cultivation approvals from six companies after thirteen inspections, citing storage, reporting, documentation and stock discrepancies. The Health Ministry announced checks across 43 licensed entities. It also promised stronger legislation after the inspections, rather than announcing that a new law was already in force.

reports.title: Senegal police intercept a cannabis convoy bound for Guinea-Bissau
reports.summary: Police arrested a courier near Sédhiou on 21 February 2026 with part of a 56 kg cannabis convoy bound for Guinea-Bissau; his accomplice fled, leaving a loaded bicycle.[@1] Senegal's Ziguinchor customs seized more than 10 tonnes of cannabis between January and June 2026, already above the 5.168 tonnes taken by all southern units in the whole of 2025, with cannabis moving opposite to the cashew…

reports.title: Police report ten suspects in the cannabis-production investigation
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry reported a criminal complaint against ten people suspected of unlawful drug production and distribution under Article 215. Two suspects were in 48-hour custody, and investigators were examining links to cannabis seized in Serbia. The ministry said some inspected companies operated lawfully; the complaint was not a conviction.

reports.title: Kandahar destroys almost a tonne of cannabis
reports.summary: Kandahar's anti-narcotics unit destroyed 993 kilograms of cannabis as part of more than 27 tonnes of drugs burned over five months in Arghandab district. The haul also included 2,766 kg of opium, 9.7 kg of methamphetamine and 1 kg of heroin. In Kabul, police arrested 123 people over a week and seized 15 kg of hashish, while 50,000 stimulant tablets were seized in Nangarhar.

reports.title: Tajikistan reports 2.7 tonnes of drugs seized on the Afghan border
reports.summary: The head of Tajikistan's Drug Control Agency said about 2,742 kg of narcotics were seized along the border with Afghanistan in 2025, and the authorities said trafficking from Afghanistan had risen by nearly half over 2024.

reports.title: Police seize a licensed cannabis import at Moshoeshoe I airport
reports.summary: Banel (Pty) Ltd imported 500 kg of dried cannabis flower from Thailand under a permit dated 27 February 2026; police seized it without producing a warrant. The High Court later set aside the seizure and ordered the cannabis returned. The case exposed the gap between the licensed import route and police practice.

reports.title: Zambia's drug agency seizes over three tonnes of cannabis in one operation
reports.summary: The Drug Enforcement Commission said its Operation Kufeza had seized about 3.3 tonnes of cannabis: 1,751.6 kg of fresh plants and 4.8 kg of seeds in Central Province, 1,478 kg from cultivation in Nkeyema District in Western Province, and 68.42 kg of packed cannabis in Senanga District. Twelve suspects were arrested and were to appear in court.

reports.title: Belgrade prosecutors link the five-tonne seizure to an earlier cannabis case
reports.summary: Belgrade’s Higher Public Prosecutor said the Konjuh seizure followed investigative work in its earlier two-tonne Zemun case. The office publicly questioned when the organised-crime prosecutor became involved and why inspectors had notified it. The statement exposed a dispute over the investigation’s handling while the cases continued.

reports.title: Mongolia's drug crimes rise 21.6 per cent in 2025
reports.summary: The State General Prosecutor's Office recorded 551 drug-related crimes in 2025, 21.6 per cent more than in 2024, and police arrested 417 people. More than 40.7 per cent of those arrested were aged 25 to 35. The prosecutor's office said ignorance of the drug laws and attempts to make easy money helped explain the increase; the figures cover all drugs.

reports.title: The Taliban burn 2.7 tonnes of cannabis in Uruzgan
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry said counter-narcotics officers found a 2,700-kilogram cannabis shipment in Chinaratu district of Uruzgan province and destroyed it by burning. In the same announcement it reported 37 kilograms of opium seized in Farah and four arrests there. The Uruzgan haul was the largest cannabis seizure reported in the period reviewed.

reports.title: Jordan raids marijuana farms and arrests 35 in a nationwide sweep
reports.summary: Police arrested 35 people in 13 drugs-and-weapons cases across Jordan in early February 2026. Raids on three marijuana-growing sites in Southern Shouneh led to two arrests, and in Amman officers detained four dealers with 5 kg of marijuana; they also seized hashish blocks, crystal meth and firearms in Ma'an, Zarqa, Ajloun and Ramtha.

reports.title: Thailand counts 7,297 cannabis shops closed
reports.summary: Public Health Ministry data to 28 December 2025 showed 18,433 cannabis shops had been operating, but 8,636 licences expired during 2025 and only 1,339 were renewed. Another 7,297 shops closed, leaving 11,136 in business. The closures followed the June 2025 prescription rule and the requirement for trained staff and medical-style premises.

reports.title: Serbia reports a record five-tonne marijuana seizure near Kruševac
reports.summary: The Interior Ministry announced about five tonnes of marijuana seized near Kruševac, calling it a record national drug seizure. It reported two arrests and a search for another suspect, alongside seized firearms. Authorities suspected unlawful production and distribution.

reports.title: Brunei keeps a 499-gram cannabis importer behind bars
reports.summary: The High Court refused bail to a man charged with importing 499.89 g of cannabis at Sungai Tujoh on 1 January 2024. Because the amount was just under the 500 g death threshold, the charge was amended to the 330–500 g band, carrying twenty to thirty years and fifteen strokes. He had been in remand for nearly two years.

reports.title: Yemen's government counts nearly three tonnes of hashish seized
reports.summary: The drug control administration of the interior ministry of Yemen's internationally recognised government reported 2,986 kg of hashish seized in 2025 in the governorates it controls, beside 1,530 kg of crystal methamphetamine, 169 kg of heroin and 482,596 Captagon pills. It counted 704 drug cases, 488 of them for use, and 1,260 suspects, of whom 827 were users.

reports.title: Bahrain appeal court cuts a cannabis-seed sentence to ten years
reports.summary: An appeal court reduced a man’s sentence from fifteen years to ten and retained a 5,000-dinar fine and confiscation in a cannabis-seed and multiple-drug case, The Daily Tribune reported.[@1] Prosecutors said he held cannabis seeds for trafficking and hashish and pregabalin for personal use; investigators described a home-growing operation.[@1] Laboratory tests identified viable cannabis seeds…

reports.title: Togo burns over five tonnes of cannabis seized in 2024
reports.summary: Togo reported burning more than 5,291 kg of cannabis seized across the country in 2024, within a total of 5,729.05 kg of drugs destroyed at Agoè in Lomé. The anti-drug office and national anti-drug committee supervised the operation. Security minister Calixte Batossie Madjoulba presented the destruction as part of the government’s effort to protect public health and young people.

reports.title: Algeria sets drug tests for job applicants and pupils
reports.summary: Two decrees of 14 January 2026 set the rules for the drug tests introduced by the 2025 drug law. Job applicants in the public and private sectors must file a negative test taken within the previous three months; a positive result blocks the application until the person completes treatment, though the decree says it is not a permanent exclusion.

reports.title: Police clear R2.9 million dagga plantation on Mpumalanga river bank
reports.summary: Acting on a tip-off, a large team led by Mpumalanga's acting police commissioner removed a dense field of mature dagga plants on Buffelspruit Farm near Malelane, valued at about R2.9 million. No arrests were made; police opened an investigation to find the cultivators.
reports.place: Buffelspruit Farm near Schoemansdal, outside Malelane, Mpumalanga

reports.title: El Salvador reports 395 kg of marijuana among 25 tonnes of drugs
reports.summary: Defence minister René Merino Monroy presented the security cabinet's figures for 2025: 25,011.05 kg of drugs seized, against 17,224.8 kg in 2024. Cocaine made up 24,612.59 kg of the total; marijuana accounted for 394.52 kg, valued at about 1.39 million dollars.

reports.title: Customs finds 40 kg of hashish oil in chocolate syrup bottles
reports.summary: Customs officers inspecting sea freight on 25 December 2025 found more than 40 kg of hashish oil hidden in bottles labelled as chocolate syrup. Police estimated the street value at over MVR 30 million and arrested two men, aged 47 and 57, on 26 and 27 December; both were remanded for five days. Hashish oil is a cannabis concentrate and is treated as a Schedule 1 drug.

reports.title: Kiribati suspends a prison sentence for two cannabis plants
reports.summary: Tom Utimawa pleaded guilty to cultivating Indian hemp after police found two plants in his backyard and dried leaves in his sleeping hut. The High Court sentenced him on 23 December 2025 to 18 months in prison suspended for two years and a A$600 fine. The primary judgment was blocked; the details come from a case summary.

reports.title: The Supreme Court upholds the Kian delos Santos murder conviction
reports.summary: The Supreme Court affirmed the murder conviction of three policemen for killing 17-year-old Kian delos Santos during a 2017 anti-drug operation in Caloocan. It upheld reclusion perpetua without parole and 275,000 pesos in damages, rejecting the officers' claim that the teenager had fought back. The decision was dated 11 August 2025 and made public on 22 December.

reports.title: Gibraltar fines a man £800 for possessing 127 grams of cannabis resin
